first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The gray-black metal handgun held by Person A in the foreground, with a slender upper body.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The dark, undulating muddy ground and gravel strip extending into the distance around Vehicle A.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: The dim gray ruined wall in the middle-to-far background on the image-right side of Vehicle A; an incomplete top edge and rectangular opening are discernible in its rear section.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The whitish-gray, dark-gray to gray-brown cloud-filled sky in the upper background.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: The warm-colored firelight in the scene, including the bright yellow-white flame near the lower edge of the image-right end of Vehicle A at the end of the clip.

entities.name: damaged vertical flag
entities.identification: The slender flagpole and flag cloth with light and dark bands on the image-right side of Vehicle A, above the ruined wall.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The large mud-covered tracked armored vehicle nearby on the left, with a short side-mounted cannon, an outlined cross, a circular emblem, and an F14 marking on its side.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The weapon holder in the first-person view, wearing dark gloves and gray-green sleeves; only the hands and forearms are visible.

entities.name: ruins smoke cloud
entities.identification: The gray-brown translucent smoke and dust covering the lower part of Vehicle A, the ground, and the distant ruined wall.

entities.name: airborne debris
entities.identification: The dark particles and irregular small chunks scattering above Vehicle A and outside its outline.

In frame 0, the muddy shell-cratered ground is dark gray-brown, with an undulating muddy surface mixed with a large amount of gray gravel; angular stones of varying sizes, localized light, wet surfaces, and strip-shaped fragments are visible.
In frame 0, the smoke-cloud-filled sky is covered by large areas of whitish-gray and dark-gray clouds, and the upper-right part of the image is brighter.

In frame 0, the smoke-cloud-filled sky consists of large areas of whitish-gray and dark-gray clouds, with blurred cloud edges and layers of varying brightness; the bright area in the upper right shows diffuse light and transitions softly into the darker area.

In frame 0, Vehicle A is a large dark gray-green tracked armored vehicle with a mud-covered body, a roughly diamond-shaped track-side outline, a short side-mounted cannon, and a top frame, with prominent light-colored markings on its side.

In frame 0, Vehicle A is a large dark gray-green tracked armored vehicle; its mud-covered side has a roughly diamond-shaped track-side outline, a short side-mounted cannon, and a mesh frame on top. Portions of the track plates, rivet points, the muzzle, a light-colored outlined cross, a circular emblem, and the text F14 are visible.
In frame 0, Person A's exposed two hands wear dark gloves, and the forearms are covered by gray-green sleeves.

In frame 0, Person A's two hands wear dark gloves, and the forearms are covered by gray-green sleeves; the gloves have stitching and bent creases, the wrists have straps and round buckles, a row of round metal buttons is visible on the left cuff, and the fabric has mottled dark and light stains.
In frame 0, the airborne debris consists of scattered dark fragments.
In frame 0, the airborne debris consists of scattered dark particles and irregular small chunks distributed above Vehicle A and outside its edges, varying in size and density.

In frame 119, Vehicle A is a large mud-covered dark gray-green tracked armored vehicle; its sloping side, the upturned track at the image-right end, a short side-mounted cannon, and part of the top frame are visible, while the left and upper parts are cut off.
